question: Does a stranger installing the PUBLISHED v0.2.8 tag get an actionable refusal for the lease-helper prerequisite, instead of the measured v0.2.7 defect?
method: real install from the published tag into an empty directory (`npm install github:auroraxo/signerd#v0.2.8`), then the documented quickstart verbatim, then the three prerequisite states — no network beyond the install itself

quickstart.note: both succeeded WITHOUT a compiler, as before — the helper is only needed at `run`

cases.label: no compiler (CC points at a path that cannot exist)
cases.firstLine: grant_file_lease_unavailable: the C compiler "/nonexistent/cc-for-verify" was not found — signerd builds the lease helper from source, so it needs one
cases.fixLine: fix: install a C compiler (cc), or point CC at one: CC=/path/to/cc signerd run ...   # the lease helper is built from tools/leasecheck.c, so the daemon needs a compiler once

cases.label: read-only install directory (node_modules/signerd/tools chmod 555)
cases.firstLine: grant_file_lease_unavailable: the lease helper could not be written to /tmp/signerd-v028-verify/node_modules/signerd/tools — the compiler ran, but that directory is not writable
cases.fixLine: fix: make the install directory writable (or pre-build it there: cc -O2 -o tools/leasecheck tools/leasecheck.c)   # the helper must be written next to its shipped source

contrastWithV027.note: measured 2026-11-07 in /tmp/signerd-nocc, the same empty-directory install; the raw log is kept at run-nocc.log

incidentalRefusalObserved.what: the first attempt used a sandbox directory with mode 775; the product refused the passphrase file before the daemon started
incidentalRefusalObserved.message: passphrase-file must not live in a group/other writable directory (mode 775)
incidentalRefusalObserved.fix: fix: chmod 700 /tmp/signerd-v028-verify/sb   # a stranger could replace the file there
incidentalRefusalObserved.significance: the passphrase trap the README pins (275) fires on a stranger's temp directory and names its repair — not part of this fix, observed live on the published tag

reason: all five verdict fields must hold on the PUBLISHED tag, not the checkout
